title: Prisma 7: 'PrismaClient was instantiated without any options. A driver adapter is required'
symptoms: PrismaClient was instantiated without any options. A driver adapter is required to connect to your database.
PrismaClientConstructorValidationError: Using engine type "client" requires either "adapter" or "accelerateUrl" to be provided to PrismaClient constructor.
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading '__internal')
SyntaxError: The requested module '@prisma/client' does not provide an export named 'PrismaClient'
cause: The Prisma 7 client has no built-in database driver, so every PrismaClient needs a driver adapter or an Accelerate URL. Code and examples written for Prisma 6 call new PrismaClient() with no arguments.
fix: Install the adapter for your database, pass it to the constructor, and import PrismaClient from the generated client folder set by the generator output, not from @prisma/client.
affected: Prisma ORM 7.0 and later, reproduced on 7.10.0
